## About
The Tree Tender is Nickey Bishop's tree service in Austin. He has been working in trees for decades, studied botany in college, and thinks of himself as a tree doctor. He's rated 5 stars from 61 Google reviews.
Nickey keeps the business small on purpose. That way he can manage the crew himself and make sure every job is done right and done safely. He still does the climbing, and he works out on the limbs all the way to the ends.
He's in this work because he loves trees, so he won't take down a living one. If you want someone to care for the trees you have, he'd be glad to come take a look.

## Services
- Pruning: A Class 2 pruning takes every limb to its end, leaving only the little twigs. You can order more or less detail to fit your budget.
- Thinning and shaping: Opening up and shaping the canopy so the tree stays healthy and balanced.
- Cabling, bracing and cavity treatment: Support and repair work for limbs and trunks that need help.
- Ball moss, mistletoe and dead limb removal: Clearing out ball moss, mistletoe and dead wood.
- Diagnostics and consultations: Help figuring out what's wrong with a tree and how to care for it. One reviewer said Nickey gave great advice for bringing a struggling chocolate mimosa back.

## FAQ
Q: Do you cut down trees?
A: No. Nickey doesn't have the heart to kill a living tree, even when it needs to be done. He focuses on caring for the trees you want to keep.

Q: Do all my trees have to be done at once?
A: No. The work can be done all at once or in stages over time, whatever suits you and your budget.

Q: I want to prune my own trees. Can you help?
A: Call Nickey first. He'll give you pointers on choosing and making cuts, plus some safety tips, at no cost to you.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: Austin is the focus, and Nickey also works in the surrounding area.
